biography:
Over 9 years of experience in energy and civil construction, I specialize in leading utility infrastructure projects that power the the cutting edge of technology in the data center space. 

From greenfield developments to complex upgrades in live environments, I manage the full project lifecycle for electric utility infrastructure, including substations, transmission lines, and distribution systems. I bring a strong understanding of the technical, regulatory, and logistical challenges unique to data center power demands, working closely with utilities, contractors, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution at every phase.
